description: Constellation Brands, Inc. is an international producer and marketer of beer, wine and spirits with operations in the U.S., Mexico, New Zealand and Italy and powerful, consumer-connected, high-quality brands like Modelo Especial, Corona Extra, Pacifico, Victoria, Kim Crawford, Ruffino, The Prisoner Wine Company, Robert Mondavi Winery, Mi CAMPO and High West. In the U.S. it is one of the top dollar share gainers among beverage alcohol suppliers, is the second-largest beer company, and has the number one beer brand, Modelo Especial, in dollar sales in the U.S. Within wine and spirits it has implemented a multi-year strategy that repositioned the business to a portfolio of exclusively higher-end brands positioned for long-term growth, aligned to its focus on consumer-led premiumization trends, and it reports its operating results in three segments: Beer, Wine and Spirits, and elsewhere.
